commit_sha_convention: Implementation commit for the Desktop Controller Session Scheduler.
actual_changes: Replaced Task Scheduler as the primary mechanism with an in-process WinForms five-minute session timer.
Controller always starts AUTO MODE OFF; ON starts at most one watcher.ps1 -Once per interval and closing stops the timer.
Install creates only the current-user Desktop shortcut and removes the legacy Crystal Startup launcher; no Task Scheduler, service, WakeToRun, login trigger, or admin dependency.
Watcher retains lock, clean-worktree safety, retry cap 2, backoff, log rotation near 4 MiB, workspace-write/on-request, and full Git path preference.
scheduler_mechanism_interval: 300000 ms (5 minutes), WinForms timer while controller window is open
retry_cap_backoff: 2 automatic retries per fingerprint, at least 5 minutes apart, then BLOCKED
log_cap: watcher.log plus watcher.log.1, approximately 2 MiB each (about 4 MiB total)
tests_or_checks: controller TestMode: OFF skip, dry-run, and 300000 ms interval checks passed
shortcut launch observed and controller closed immediately; no watcher remained
no Task Scheduler object was created
full Git path retained; no business task executed

performance_resource_impact.cpu: Idle between timer ticks; transient during one-shot poll
performance_resource_impact.network: zero while controller is closed or AUTO OFF; only one-shot poll while ON or manual check

critical_boundaries_preserved: No P2A-2R or other business task executed
No database or semantic data modified
No system PATH or admin settings changed
next_minimum_action: None; do not start a subsequent business phase.
